notes.title: L33na Has Launched – Let the Hunt Begin
notes.content: [p]L33na and her crew are finally hitting the grid. In a decaying world shaped by machine cults and corporate manipulation, rival gangs race to retrieve scattered fragments—pieces of a powerful artifact left behind by the elusive Puritarchs.[/p][p]Play solo or alongside the chaos of unpredictable factions. Every encounter is a test of wit, survival, and strategy. Can you stay ahead long enough to put the pieces together?[/p][p]Your mission starts now. The signal is live.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Introducing the L33na Redpepper game
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like [u][b]URP and HDRP[/b][/u], and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. [u][b]We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience.[/b][/u][/p][p]While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future.[/p][p]For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41289167/3dd2b276cfffa8415ff33684b29c5ad69d0ec140.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 1st Game Update
notes.content:
We are introducing changes to the game.
The cutscene system has been replaced with a more interactive mechanism. This mechanism will be the way to a new version that we will introduce in the next update.
